instruction: A cheerful and candid lifestyle photograph with a joyful, energetic mood. In a medium shot at eye-level against a plain white wall, the woman with short black hair (R3) stands on the left wearing a white t-shirt and light blue denim shorts, laughing happily with her mouth open as she looks off-camera to the right. She holds a small American flag on a wooden stick in her raised right hand. To her right, the woman with long straight black hair (R4) wears a light blue t-shirt and light blue denim shorts, laughing with her mouth open as she leans her head and shoulder against the other woman's left shoulder, resting her right hand there. The scene is illuminated by bright, even studio lighting from the front, creating a clean, bright color palette with minimal shadows.
